metadata.title: Resolution of the Chairman of the Supreme Council of Health No. (21) of 2022 amending the Regulation issued by Resolution No. (32) of 2020
metadata.edition: Issued 6 April 2022, Official Gazette No. 3597 of 7 April 2022, in force the day after publication · amends arts. 13 and 20-22 (imports, clinical-study imports); no pharmacovigilance provision
metadata.legal_basis: Supreme Council of Health resolution; the Official Gazette text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
